title: Drive a parse from tables
description: You can follow the state stack through shift, reduce, accept, and error cases.

steps.description: PRODUCTIONS records reduction lengths. ACTION chooses a move from a state and token, while GOTO selects the state after a reduction.
The driver appends the end marker and starts in state zero. Each iteration looks up the current state and input token.
A missing entry returns an error. Accept returns the top symbol; shift pushes a token and advances the input.

steps.question: Which state does GOTO use after a reduction pops entries?
steps.answer: It uses the state exposed on top of the stack after the pop.

steps.description: Reduction replaces the right-hand symbols with the production's left-hand symbol. The new state comes from GOTO.
The first displayed parse accepts with E on the stack. The final call supplies a malformed token sequence for the driver's error path.
